name: paycontrol-customer-feedback
description: Weekly customer feedback report — reads #paycontrol-feedback, classifies items, matches to GitHub issues, posts to #paycontrol-reports. Runs every Friday at 07:30 Stockholm time.

payload.message:
Read the skill file at <WORKSPACE>/skills/paycontrol-customer-requirements/SKILL.md and execute all instructions in it exactly as written.

Credentials:
- SLACK_TOKEN=<SLACK_TOKEN>
- GH_TOKEN=<GH_TOKEN>
- WEBHOOK=<SLACK_WEBHOOK_PAYCONTROL_REPORTS>

Set all three as env vars before running.
